realms.name: The Sky (Nebo)
realms.description: The highest heaven, the realm of Nebo (the sky-father) and Perun (the thunder-god) [S4][S5].

realms.name: The Earth (Zemlya)
realms.description: The human world, the realm of the earth-gods and the fertility deities [S4][S5].

realms.name: The Underworld (Nav / Cherd)
realms.description: The realm of the dead, the domain of Veles and Cherd [S4][S5][S6].

structure_notes: The Slavic cosmos is three-layered: the Sky (Nebo) above, the Earth (Zemlya) in the middle, and the Underworld (Nav/Cherd) below. A world-axis (the world-tree, the 'axis mundi') connects the three layers [S5][S6]. This is a scholarly reconstruction from folk belief and comparative evidence [S6].
